name: Closure conditioning
description: Separate conditioning and uniqueness audit for the production 8x8 mechanical closure and the 2x2 stick-root map.

physical.definition: exact static-capacity intervals from the frozen contact law

expanded.definition: signed half-width max(2.5, 4x largest physical static magnitude)

interpretation_boundaries: Only the physical lambda domain is interpreted as statically admissible for the frozen Baja model.
Expanded and broad domains are mathematical diagnostics, not claimed operating regions.
det(J_R) is retained as a geometric diagnostic; singular values and kappa(J_R) are the formal conditioning measures.
Broad-domain feature associations are not automatically promoted to causal physical explanations.
